notes: source.epoch.tasks.v1 (cards T08-COMPOSE and REGION-CREDIT-JOINS): a flat-epoch plan over a real checked scoped-task region whose parent, after its one spawn and its one join, writes an `error region` that credits 5, spends 2 and takes its decided error edge; the catch's `quant open R as pack` binds the sealed pack as a linear capability and `discharge pack;` abandons exactly the parent-local remainder 3 -- an explicit AbandonCredit event of the unedited qcore_core::error_region model, never an omission. That is CT22's scenario, `quant opening discards parent-local unused credit after joins`, expected Accept, and the case is ADMITTED with every word of it a checked fact: `quant opening` and `discards` by the model's own AbandonCredit on the discharge; `parent-local` by the duty-free pack (the composed body admits no acquisition, REGION-JOINS-DUTIES) plus the after-joins IR rule (every TrySpawn/Join span of the checked region precedes the region statement, so no child exists and no child holds any grant at the opening); `unused credit` by the published abandoned_credit, which the driver re-derives from an independent fold of the written statements before publication; `after joins` by the Q600 refusal when false, in both directions. The runner compares the published abandoned/restored/spent split wholesale: the case's own credit-recovery split (the elided error arm's all-spent reading, restored + spent = grant, error path commits the spent part) and the region evidence's abandoned figure, re-asserting the duty-free pack and the join-before-region span fact on the published objects. The region erases from emission (the emitted C, source map and reference observation are measured byte-identical with and without it by compiler/tests/region_credit_joins.rs), The composed module publishes no reference observation of its own, which is why card CT-COMPOSED-NATIVE (wave 32) compares the emitted program against the reference execution of this module's own checked task half instead: that run is real native and sanitizer evidence about the emitted program (see composed_native below), and it remains no proof evidence and no evidence whatever about the credit quantities, which erase from emission.

controls.note: Attribution: case.qr with exactly the region removed. Admitted with no region evidence and the identical credit-recovery split, so the case's abandoned figure is the region's own publication and the region moves nothing either epoch checker already published.

Boundary: the parent spends its whole credit before the edge, so the sealed pack's remainder is zero and the discharge abandons nothing -- the published quantity is a real fold of the written statements, not a flag.

Both compositions in one entry: error(move); restores the whole grant on the creator's derived error edges (CT23's law) while the parent's own region epilogue abandons 3 on the success path -- two unedited models, two published quantities, one entry.

The `after joins` half of the scenario, refused when false in the join direction: the region is written between the spawn and the join, so the child is live and holds its grant at the region's entry. Derived from the checked task IR, and the message names the card rule.
The same rule's spawn direction: the region written before the creation itself. Both directions of the after-joins premise are gates, not conventions.

The duty-free-pack premise, refused when false: a region acquisition would seal a live duty into the pack, and the composed route refuses it by name (REGION-JOINS-DUTIES) -- which is what makes `parent-local` mean `only the remainder`.

CT21's shape reached from this route: the opening binds the pack and the handler walks away with the capability live. The unedited model's own refusal at its own code -- discarding the credit is admitted only through the discharge, never through silence.
The other way to walk away: the nonempty pack caught without being opened. Q305 and Q306 together are why the case's explicit AbandonCredit is the ONLY writable way to discard the remainder.
An opening that names a region other than the one whose pack this clause holds, refused by the unedited model at its own Q303 -- the capability is the region's own.

composed_native.note: Card CT-COMPOSED-NATIVE (wave 32), discharging the follow-on this case's own unassessed emission and native rows named. The case's own emitted C -- the task route's program, into whose blanks the region erased -- is compiled with the platform C compiler under ASan/UBSan (plus LSan on Linux) and run, and its standard output is compared byte for byte with render_task_observation of the reference execution of this same module's own checked task half (ComposedEpochModule::tasks, the unedited qcore_core::task_execution interpreter). The transcript is pinned here so the comparison is against a stated rendering rather than against whatever the two sides happen to agree on. OBSERVED, NOT PROVED: one successful run on one host with one compiler under these sanitizers, on the all-success script. It says the emitted program's transcript equalled the checked task half's, that it wrote nothing to standard error and that it exited 0 -- and on Linux, where LSan runs, that the buffer the worker allocated and the parent dropped was reclaimed. It says nothing about schedules, inputs or hosts this run did not take, and nothing whatever about the credit quantities: the region and the flat-epoch plan erase from emission, so credit 5, effort 2 and the abandoned remainder 3 are check-time folds measured by the epoch_credit_split mode and by no byte of this run. The case's proof stage stays unassessed.
